TRIPWIRE R3 (branch spike/r3-sram, never merged; DECISIONS D-031): the SRAM macro block below
and the four FP_PDN_V* stripe keys are the only changes to the template. They follow the recipe
the Loom entry (github.com/thomasgilbert481/tt_um_loom, Apache-2.0) took through hardening,
precheck and gl_test on its 2x2 branch sram-smoke, with our instance path.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
MACROS: key = macro name. instances: key = the FLATTENED instance path Yosys produces
(tt_um_tripwire -> u_sram (trw_sram) -> sram; checked with a local flatten). location/orientation
as in Loom's 2x2 smoke test: lower-left (12, 40), FS (mirrored about X) so the signal pins face
the logic above it and the Metal4 power columns stay vertical. Macro 236.80 x 191.34 um.
Files are vendored in macro/ at IHP-Open-PDK 2bbec755 (macro/.../README.md). nl = the port-only
blackbox in src/, not the behavioural model. lib keys name the process corner.
PDN_MACRO_CONNECTIONS: <instance> <power net> <ground net> <macro power pin> <macro ground pin>.
Periphery (VDD!) and array (VDDARRAY!) supplies both go to VPWR; Tiny Tapeout has one rail.
PDN_CFG: LibreLane's default PDN script with the macro grid replaced (Loom's src/pdn_cfg.tcl,
verbatim below a provenance header, Apache-2.0, sram-smoke commit c7000671). On cmos5l the default macro grid (Metal4 <-> TopMetal1) is empty; the
script runs the Metal4 stripes through the macro's same-net power columns and verifies them.
Loom's smoke-test cap on detailed-routing iterations (bounds a failing run on a small die).
SRAM GDS has no PR boundary layer; read the full GDS instead of a blackbox.
Magic's cmos5l tech reports DRC inside the SRAM macro (no SRAM exceptions); the precheck's
KLayout deck is the sign-off DRC and checks the merged GDS.
Magic reports the POWER stripes crossing the macro's Metal4 OBS at the VDD!/VDDARRAY! split as
illegal overlaps (checked by Loom: no real metal there; LVS and KLayout DRC pass). The count
stays in the metrics (magic__illegal_overlap__count): expect only those crossings.
Blackbox the SRAM macro during SPICE extraction for LVS: the IHP macros are not LVS clean.
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html

pdn_cfg.tcl). Template values: VPITCH 50, VWIDTH 2.1, no VSPACING/VOFFSET.
VPITCH 67.44 = 6 x 11.24 um (the macro's same-net column pitch), VSPACING 3.52 (ground stripe
5.62 um from power), VOFFSET 26.36 (first power stripe at x 29.24 = macro x 12 + 17.24).
VWIDTH stays 2.1, the precheck's minimum power-port width on cmos5l.
